items.title: Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline following cyber incident
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions suspended online benefit services on Friday after detecting suspicious activity.

items.title: Orvia Underwriting appoints Rob Corner as UK CEO and Nick Hobbs as UK Chair
items.summary: Orvia Underwriting has appointed Rob Corner as UK chief executive and Nick Hobbs as chair as part of Ardonagh's consolidation of its global managing general agent operations.

items.title: Lloyd’s warns managing agents against broadening coverage as market softens
items.summary: Lloyd's has cautioned managing agents against rolling back coverage too extensively in order to compete outside of pricing.

items.title: Investment Week celebrates tenth anniversary of Women in Investment Awards
items.summary: Investment Week marked the tenth anniversary of the Women in Investment Awards with a ceremony in London.

items.title: Corrective work on surgery done abroad raises clinic liability questions
items.summary: An increase in UK clinic patients seeking corrective surgery performed abroad is highlighting gaps in liability wordings and missing operative records.

items.title: Lloyd's links post-loss capital recovery to market appetite and underwriting cycle
items.summary: Lloyd's has announced that rebuilding capital following a major market loss depends on prevailing conditions and investor appetite, as it sets a 2027 timetable for firm-specific feedback after the PRA's stress test.
